title: Policy change — authorizations cannot outlive the policy that granted them
expected: old authorizations cannot execute after a policy change; new decisions follow the new policy
actual: authorizations are single-use inside one execute() call; actionId reuse refused as replay; fresh attempts follow the current policy immediately; policy change cannot be circumvented
observations: (2) reuse refused: ReplayDetectedError: replay detected for action act_s06_v1; authorization cannot be reused
(2b) cross-deployment reuse (fresh store, same actionId): executed=true, decision=ALLOW — action ids are store-scoped; the replay guarantee is per deployment
(3) fresh attempt decision: ALLOW under risk=CRITICAL; new policy applied immediately
(4-variant) same intent under a refusing policy: DENY — policy "deploy": required dependency is INVALID — a precondition failed against current state. Action risk MEDIUM. Decis

block_classifications.detail: action-id uniqueness is per deployment (store-scoped); agents hitting two independent SSF deployments with the same id are outside the single-deployment replay guarantee (documented scope)
the changed policy governs the fresh decision; nothing inherited

notes: Binding model (documented as measured): policy binds at decision time per attempt. There is no durable cross-call authorization; escalation approval additionally binds to approved semantics and re-verifies freshness (covered by S10/S11).
